summary: Iteration 107 — Unified CMS menu (SiteNav + MenuManager) + Interior Design AI rate limit fully tested and passing. All 17 backend tests pass. All 19 frontend flows pass (10 guest mobile+desktop, 4 client auth, 5 admin menu manager) + design-interior regression. Deactivation via UI hides from public menu; reset restores. Rate limit 429 with Romanian message verified via public URL.

minor.issue: Rate limit is in-memory per-worker, keyed on `request.client.host` which behind K8s ingress is the ingress IP. Effectively works as a GLOBAL rate limit (all users share the same bucket) rather than per real user IP. To be per-IP, should read X-Forwarded-For header. Also state is lost on backend reload (uvicorn --reload).

action_items: (Optional) Improve rate limiting to be truly per-IP by reading X-Forwarded-For (starlette Request.headers). Currently behind ingress, all traffic looks like the same IP and any spammer can DOS the endpoint for all users after 10 hits.
(Optional) Persist rate-limit counters to Redis/Mongo so state survives backend reloads.

site_menu.py `_sanitize_items` correctly caps depth at 1 (children of children ignored) — good defense-in-depth.
SiteNav.jsx line 62 `resolveHref` replaces `/dashboard` prefix with role — works for /dashboard and /dashboard#proiecte etc. Handles logout via special `#logout` href. Nice pattern.
MenuManagerPage.jsx uses browser `window.confirm` (line 110) for reset — works but a shadcn Dialog would be more consistent with rest of admin UI.
interior_design.py:174 rate limit dict `_ai_hits` is process-global and never garbage-collects old IPs — small memory leak over months of uptime. Consider clearing IPs whose hits list is empty.
SiteNav initial render: `visible` is empty until axios finishes → tiny FOUC on desktop nav (empty then flashes items). Consider skeleton or SSR fallback.
